cohort: 1145 male patients who attended the Pediatric Orthopedic Clinic for a DDH check up at the Orthopedic Section, Special Surgery Department, Faculty of Medicine, The University of Jordan, Amman, Jordan between March 2011 and October 2014.
finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly associated with an increased risk of hip dislocation, while normal delivery was significantly associated with acetabular dysplasia.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly associated with an increased risk of hip dislocation, while normal delivery was significantly associated with acetabular dysplasia.
